{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
# Handle thousands separators
data['revenue'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check if revenue is now numeric
print(f"Revenue dtype after conversion: {data['revenue'].dtype}")
print(f"First few converted revenue values: {data['revenue'].head().tolist()}")

# Check for QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_orders = data[data['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Remove QA orders
data_clean = data[data['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Check status: only 'completed' should be in the population
print(f"Status distribution after removing QA: {data_clean['status'].value_counts().to_dict()}")

# Check channels
print(f"Channel distribution: {data_clean['channel'].value_counts().to_dict()}")"}
